children: IDEX entered into a second amended and restated Credit Agreement establishing an unsecured $800 million revolving credit facility for working capital and general corporate purposes, including debt refinancing. The facility now matures on September 3, 2031, with two optional one-year extensions, and includes up to $100 million for letters of credit and a $50 million same-day swingline. Pricing is tied to IDEX’s debt rating or leverage ratio. The company also has a $400 million accordion feature to increase commitments, enhancing liquidity and flexibility.
: Bank of America, as administrative agent, and other lenders
